verdict.rationale: The Trusted Agent Protocol has a public GitHub repo with spec and a runnable reference implementation that appears readable without signup (visa-ic-supp-9, docs-11), but the core Visa Intelligent Commerce API (tokens, purchase intents, credentials) requires creating a sandbox account and accepting terms before you can even test it (visa-ic-supp-10), which contradicts 'without signing anything' for the actual commerce protocol a developer would implement. Missing for 10: explicit version numbers/spec versioning for either protocol, evidence that full IC API docs/spec can be read and implemented with zero account/terms requirement, and independent confirmation of unrestricted access.
